uncertainty: Fourteen distinct Maven artifacts passed valid H.264/AAC MP4 controls. They include MP4Parser isoparser and muxer, metadata-extractor, JCodec, Apache Tika MP4Parser, JavaCV, the direct Bytedeco FFmpeg binding, Jaffree, bramp FFmpeg, JAVE2, Imagic FFmpeg Java, the v47 Jaffree fork, vlcj-info, and the amilesend MediaInfo JNA wrapper. Package paths are not independent parser implementations: isoparser and muxer share MP4Parser, Tika uses metadata-extractor, seven paths rely on FFmpeg/FFprobe, and two paths use libmediainfo. The amilesend API rejects files below 65536 bytes, so its control appends a valid top-level free box to the original MP4; the generator and both SHA-256 checks are recorded. The Bytedeco paths require pinned macOS arm64 native JARs; JAVE2 bundles a pinned native executable; the FFprobe wrappers use a SHA-256-locked local FFprobe 9.0.2 executable; vlcj-info uses pinned local libmediainfo and libzen. Five bounded Maven Solr queries used 100-result limits. The mp4 query saved 100 of 350 hits, mp4 parser saved six, and Java MP4 saved 18; isoparser and ISO base media timed out. These are 124 saved hits, 120 unique; refresh timeouts preserved earlier successful windows. Most Java MP4 hits use mp for unrelated software; 18 remain unreviewed search hits. The MP4Parser aggregate POM and ytk-mp4j message-passing library were rejected after documentation checks. CodecMedia 1.2.2 returned only the ftyp brand and no parsed track or dimensions; jaudiotagger 3.0.1 rejected this MP4 video control. Three targeted documentation leads remain unresolved: older and Liferay MP4Parser distributions and the streaming module. This is below the 20-path working goal and does not establish the most-used top 20. The controls prove box, track, handler, dimension, audio-rate, codec, and title parsing for these MP4 variants only. Java SE 25 official API documentation yielded no bundled MP4 parser; a JDK-only run found no ImageIO or Java Sound reader for the control. Third-party providers may add support. No vulnerability, malformed-input or resource-use experiments were run.
